reason: Runestone stacks and the soundsystem spell (Ed, 2026-10-28): no area clears by itself any more (only her spell or its wave converts a stone), invited creatures keep their sigils at their stone (no rune at their feet), and a conversion scatters every friend sigil round it on the ground.

rules.party: no areas partified early by clearing (only by the spell, which the bench's path doesn't cast)
rules.creatures: atStone and loose marks; happy ones in unconverted areas keep no rune; areas not converted early keep their wild
rules.combat: sieges and soundsystems follow the waves only (no early-cleared soundsystems)
rules.witches: her cast records (casts, casting) and the leash's tether
rules.*: any part downstream of the above

frames.wave-fight: the converted stone's friends' sigils lie loose round it instead of runes at their feet
frames.*: any scene where a stone has converted (its sigils lie loose round it) or an area would have cleared by itself
